=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:345 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The self-heal prompt builder is invoked through a checkout-relative path while GitHub credentials are present, allowing checkout-controlled code to execute before the credentialless sandbox.
  WHY: This was rated BLOCKER by qwen_qwen3_7-plus, MAJOR by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, and NIT by z-ai_glm-5_2; all identify the same credentialed execution path.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:308-329 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `run_self_heal_codex` invokes the sandbox without the stall guard or heartbeat, leaving idle model calls undetected and stall telemetry unpopulated.
  WHY: A stalled call can block validation until the sandbox wall-clock limit; this was rated BLOCKER by minimax_minimax-m3, MAJOR by the other reviewers, and NIT for the locale-independent dead telemetry aspect by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:3572-3573 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `cmp` check fails when the checkout does not contain `scripts/validate_driver.sh`, causing validation to reject the trusted staged driver.
  WHY: Consumer repositories relying on the staged support copy can exit with “Unverified validation harness” before validation runs; this was rated BLOCKER by minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and MAJOR by the other reviewers.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:757-766, 843-859, 886-905 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `env -i` invocations strip proxy configuration needed by renderer dependency installation and Semble setup on proxied self-hosted runners.
  WHY: The steps may fail to reach PyPI or other network resources; this was rated BLOCKER by google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and MAJOR by the other reviewers.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:3569-3609 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `env -i` validation-driver launch strips locale variables, potentially causing Python processes to fail on non-ASCII output or input.
  WHY: This was rated MAJOR by google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, and qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and NIT by z-ai_glm-5_2.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:3604-3605 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded `VALIDATION_INCLUDE_SYNTHESISED=false` and manifest blocklist prevent consumers from enabling synthesised behavioural smoke tests.
  WHY: Consumers who relied on those tests lose coverage with no configuration opt-in; this was rated MAJOR by minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and NIT by z-ai_glm-5_2.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:886-905 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Semble build path does not explicitly set `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=false` when it exits without producing the expected index and wrapper files.
  WHY: A previously exported `true` value can persist and cause downstream steps to treat a missing index as available.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2028-2037 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_validate_wrapper` rejects any existing `validation/validate.sh` that differs byte-for-byte from the generated template.
  WHY: Consumer repositories with customized wrappers fail closed during wrapper setup.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:127-135 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `python3()` wrapper removes `GITHUB_ENV` and `GITHUB_OUTPUT` from helper subprocesses, preventing helpers from publishing workflow values through those files.
  WHY: Helpers relying on those variables can fail or leave downstream steps without expected outputs.
- scripts/render_validation_templates.py:530-550 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The 20-file heuristic rejects legitimate rendered validation trees containing more than the allowed number of files.
  WHY: `--verify-output-root` can fail even when all generated files match the expected manifest.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Prevent branch-controlled code and Python imports from running in credentialed or privileged host contexts; use verified support and isolated execution."
  expected_change_site: All validation-related shell script execution points.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `.github/workflows/validate.yml` proxy handling and `scripts/validate_process.sh` locale handling regress under `env -i`, so isolated validation may not function in proxied or non-ASCII environments.
- requirement: "Run only the verified private-support installer [for Semble] in an isolated environment that cannot alter later step configuration."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/validate.yml` around lines 843-859 (`Install semble` step).
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The installer’s own writes to `$GITHUB_ENV` (e.g. `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` after the `python3 -E -c 'import semble.version'` smoke check) propagate into later steps.
- requirement: "Source self-heal helpers exclusively from the verified private-support directory; never preserve branch copies of executable support."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/self_heal_validation.sh`
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `run_self_heal_codex` still passes the workspace `${PWD}` as `--workspace` to `untrusted_process_sandbox.sh`; the self-heal script still calls `render_prompt.sh` via checkout-relative path at line 345; the Python processes inside `render_prompt.sh` do not use `-E/-I` isolation flags, so they can import from the checkout's `scripts/` directory with GH_TOKEN in the environment.
- requirement: "Run staging Python with isolated imports from verified support, outside the target checkout, and without GitHub credentials."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/self_heal_validation.sh` line 345 (render_prompt.sh invocation)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The self-heal script still calls render_prompt.sh via checkout-relative path at line 345. While staging overwrites the checkout copy with the verified version, the Python processes inside render_prompt.sh do not use -E/-I isolation flags, so they can import from the checkout's scripts/ directory with GH_TOKEN in the environment. Other call sites in validate_process.sh were updated to use ${_validate_script_dir}/render_prompt.sh but line 345 was not.
- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line" (11 critical findings listed in linked issue)
  expected_change_site: scripts/validate_process.sh:3604 (VALIDATION_INCLUDE_SYNTHESISED) and all self-heal/sandbox paths.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: PR diff hard-codes false and blocks it in env_overrides; self-heal stall guard and credential stripping are removed or incomplete; no regression test exercises synthesised path.
- requirement: "Make mitigations automated and fail closed, with no manual approval gate."
  expected_change_site: scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:345 and validate_process.sh:2024-2103 (renderer/driver isolation).
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: renderer preflight still runs host Python that can import checkout modules; proxy stripping is not fail-closed for self-hosted runners; no explicit gate on missing trusted driver before driver launch.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:345 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The self-heal prompt composition block invokes `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh` using a checkout-relative path while credentials remain in the process environment.
  WHY: A branch-controlled `render_prompt.sh` can execute with credentials before the sandboxed model call.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:308-327 (run_self_heal_codex) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The removal of the stall guard wrapping means a hung self-heal model call inside the sandbox has no idle detection.
  WHY: A stalled model can block validation for up to 2 hours per attempt, and up to 4 hours across two LLM attempts; `SELF_HEAL_STALL_STATE` is never populated.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:87-88, 143-158 (CODEX_HEARTBEAT_HELPER, CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER, read_codex_stall_guard_state) | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Stall-detection infrastructure is dead code after `run_self_heal_codex` stopped using the wrappers.
  WHY: The script appears to track stall events, but the state remains empty and the telemetry paths will never execute.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: lines 757-766, 843-859 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The use of `env -i` in renderer and Semble installation steps strips critical environment variables such as `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`, and other proxy configuration variables.
  WHY: On self-hosted runners operating behind corporate proxies, pip and other installation tools will be unable to reach PyPI or other network resources.
- scripts/validate_process.sh: lines 3569-3609 (validation driver execution) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The validation driver is launched with `env -i`, which wipes all environment variables, including locale-related variables like `LC_ALL` and `LANG`.
  WHY: Python processes spawned inside containers may default to ASCII encoding if locale variables are missing, leading to `UnicodeEncodeError` or similar failures when processing test fixtures or log outputs that contain non-ASCII characters.
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh: lines 308-327 (run_self_heal_codex) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The refactored `run_self_heal_codex` function unconditionally invokes `untrusted_process_sandbox.sh` without the stall guard or heartbeat helper logic previously used to detect hung model calls.
  WHY: A hung model call will now block the validation workflow for up to the sandbox's four-hour hard limit instead of the prior 600-second idle timeout, effectively deadlocking the pipeline for extended periods.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: lines 886-905 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The logic to set `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE` in `GITHUB_ENV` does not explicitly reset or unset the variable to `false` when the Semble index cannot be built.
  WHY: If a previous validation step or a stale `GITHUB_ENV` configuration has `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=true`, the current step will propagate this incorrect state even when Semble is unavailable.
- scripts/validate_process.sh: lines 3572-3573 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The check `cmp -s "scripts/validate_driver.sh" "${_validate_script_dir}/validate_driver.sh"` fails if the branch-controlled `scripts/validate_driver.sh` is absent.
  WHY: In consumer repositories that rely on staging to supply the trusted driver, this check causes validation to fail with "Unverified validation harness" instead of proceeding with the staged copy.
